chatgpt-plus.name: ChatGPT Plus
chatgpt-plus.description: OpenAI's premium subscription giving access to GPT-4o, advanced reasoning, image generation, and priority uptime. The world's most widely used AI assistant.

claude-pro.name: Claude Pro
claude-pro.description: Anthropic's premium Claude subscription with extended context, priority access, and Claude 3.5 Sonnet. Praised for long-document analysis and nuanced writing.

gemini-advanced.name: Gemini Advanced
gemini-advanced.description: Google's premium AI assistant powered by Gemini Ultra. Integrated with Gmail, Docs, and Drive. Access to Google's most capable multimodal model.

jasper-ai.name: Jasper AI
jasper-ai.description: AI writing platform for marketing teams with brand voice training, templates for ads, blogs, and emails. Used by 100,000+ businesses.

copy-ai.name: Copy.ai
copy-ai.description: AI copywriting platform with 90+ templates for sales emails, social posts, product descriptions, and long-form content.

writesonic.name: Writesonic
writesonic.description: AI writing tool for SEO blogs, ads, and landing pages. Includes Chatsonic (ChatGPT alternative) and Botsonic chatbot builder.

perplexity-pro.name: Perplexity Pro
perplexity-pro.description: AI-powered search engine that answers questions with cited sources in real time. Pro gives access to GPT-4o, Claude, and unlimited searches.

github-copilot.name: GitHub Copilot
github-copilot.description: AI pair programmer from GitHub/Microsoft that suggests code completions in VS Code, JetBrains, and more. Powers 46% of developer code at active users.

cursor-pro.name: Cursor Pro
cursor-pro.description: AI-first code editor built on VS Code with codebase-aware chat, multi-file edits, and inline AI generation. Fastest-growing AI dev tool in 2024.

tabnine-pro.name: Tabnine Pro
tabnine-pro.description: AI code completion tool with privacy-first options and support for 80+ languages. Can run locally for enterprise teams.

midjourney.name: Midjourney
midjourney.description: The leading AI image generation service known for artistic, highly aesthetic outputs. Operates through Discord. No free tier.

dalle3.name: DALL-E 3
dalle3.description: OpenAI's flagship image generation model. Integrated into ChatGPT Plus and accessible via API. Excellent at following text prompts precisely.

adobe-firefly.name: Adobe Firefly
adobe-firefly.description: Adobe's generative AI for image creation, object removal, and text effects. Integrated into Photoshop, Illustrator, and Express.

runway-ml.name: Runway ML
runway-ml.description: AI video generation and editing platform. Powers Gen-2 text-to-video and is used by professional filmmakers and content creators.

synthesia.name: Synthesia
synthesia.description: AI video platform that creates realistic talking-head videos from text using digital avatars. Used for training videos and marketing.

elevenlabs.name: ElevenLabs
elevenlabs.description: State-of-the-art AI voice synthesis and cloning platform. Industry standard for audiobook narration, dubbing, and voice content creation.

murf-ai.name: Murf AI
murf-ai.description: AI voice generator with 120+ voices in 20 languages. Popular for eLearning, podcast voiceovers, and marketing videos.

descript.name: Descript
descript.description: AI-powered podcast and video editing platform. Edit audio by editing text, remove filler words automatically, and overdub your voice.

otter-ai.name: Otter.ai
otter-ai.description: AI meeting transcription and note-taking tool. Integrates with Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams for automatic meeting summaries.

deepl-pro.name: DeepL Pro
deepl-pro.description: The highest-quality AI translation service, outperforming Google Translate in multiple benchmarks. 31 languages, document translation, and API access.

notion-ai.name: Notion AI
notion-ai.description: AI writing and summarisation add-on for Notion. Drafts documents, summarises pages, answers questions from your workspace, and auto-fills databases.

microsoft-copilot-365.name: Microsoft Copilot 365
microsoft-copilot-365.description: AI assistant deeply embedded in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams. Drafts documents, analyses data, and summarises meetings.

openai-api.name: OpenAI API
openai-api.description: Access GPT-4o, GPT-4, GPT-3.5, DALL-E, Whisper, and Embeddings via API. The most widely integrated AI API in production applications.

grammarly-premium.name: Grammarly Premium
grammarly-premium.description: AI writing assistant for grammar, spelling, style, and tone. Used by 30 million people daily. Premium adds clarity rewrites and plagiarism detection.

luma-ai.name: Luma Dream Machine
luma-ai.description: AI video generation from text or images. Known for realistic motion and physics simulation. Competes with Runway and Sora.

adobe-podcast.name: Adobe Podcast
adobe-podcast.description: AI audio enhancement tool that removes background noise and improves voice quality to studio-level. Part of Adobe Creative Cloud.

canva-ai.name: Canva AI (Magic Studio)
canva-ai.description: Canva's suite of AI tools including Magic Media (text-to-image), Magic Edit, Magic Eraser, and AI Presentations. Integrated into the Canva design platform.

open-webui.name: Open WebUI
open-webui.description: Feature-rich self-hosted web UI for running local LLMs via Ollama or OpenAI-compatible APIs. Supports RAG, plugins, multi-model conversations, and sharing.

ollama.name: Ollama
ollama.description: Run large language models locally on Mac, Linux, and Windows. One-command setup for Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma, Phi-3, and 100+ models. No data leaves your machine.

jan-ai.name: Jan
jan-ai.description: Open-source ChatGPT-alternative that runs 100% offline on your computer. Clean desktop app for Mac, Windows, Linux with model library and API server.

lm-studio.name: LM Studio
lm-studio.description: Desktop app for discovering, downloading, and running local LLMs. User-friendly interface with built-in model downloader and local API server.

anything-llm.name: AnythingLLM
anything-llm.description: Full-stack open-source RAG application. Chat with documents, websites, and databases using any LLM. Self-hostable with teams and workspaces.

privateGPT.name: PrivateGPT
privateGPT.description: Production-ready AI project for private document interaction using LLMs. 100% private — no data leaves your environment. Supports multiple LLM backends.

morphic.name: Morphic
morphic.description: Open-source AI-powered search engine with cited answers. Self-hostable Perplexity alternative using Tavily search and any LLM backend.

farfalle.name: Farfalle
farfalle.description: Open-source AI search engine that provides cited answers with follow-up questions. Supports Groq, Ollama, and OpenAI as LLM backends.

continue-dev.name: Continue
continue-dev.description: Open-source AI code assistant for VS Code and JetBrains. Connect to any LLM — Ollama, Claude, GPT-4, Gemini — for inline completions and chat.

codeium.name: Codeium
codeium.description: Free AI code acceleration toolkit supporting 70+ languages and 40+ IDEs. 100k token context window, in-editor chat, and autocomplete — free forever for individuals.

tabby.name: Tabby
tabby.description: Self-hosted AI coding assistant — an open-source GitHub Copilot alternative. Runs on your own hardware with full data privacy and VS Code/JetBrains plugins.

void-editor.name: Void
void-editor.description: Open-source Cursor alternative built on VS Code. Connect to any AI model including local Ollama models. Full codebase context and multi-file editing.

aider.name: Aider
aider.description: AI pair programmer in your terminal. Edit code across multiple files using Claude, GPT-4, or local models. Automatically commits changes to git.

stable-diffusion-webui.name: Stable Diffusion WebUI
stable-diffusion-webui.description: The most popular browser-based interface for running Stable Diffusion locally. Supports txt2img, img2img, inpainting, upscaling, and hundreds of extensions.

comfyui.name: ComfyUI
comfyui.description: Powerful node-based stable diffusion interface for advanced users. Full control over the image generation pipeline through a visual workflow editor.

fooocus.name: Fooocus
fooocus.description: Simplified offline image generation tool inspired by Midjourney. No complex settings — just type a prompt and get Midjourney-quality results locally.

invokeai.name: InvokeAI
invokeai.description: Professional-grade open-source creative engine for Stable Diffusion. Node-based canvas, controlnet support, and a polished web UI built for creative workflows.

bark.name: Bark
bark.description: Open-source text-to-audio model by Suno AI. Generates highly realistic speech with laughter, sighs, and music. Runs locally on GPU or CPU.

coqui-tts.name: Coqui XTTS
coqui-tts.description: Advanced open-source text-to-speech with voice cloning from a 3-second audio sample. Supports 16 languages and runs locally with GPU or CPU.

piper-tts.name: Piper TTS
piper-tts.description: Fast, local neural text-to-speech system optimised for Raspberry Pi. Extremely lightweight with 100+ voice models in dozens of languages.

kokoro.name: Kokoro TTS
kokoro.description: 82M parameter TTS model with near-ElevenLabs quality. State-of-the-art speech synthesis that runs on consumer hardware, Apache licensed.

whisper.name: OpenAI Whisper
whisper.description: OpenAI's open-source speech recognition model. Transcribes and translates audio in 99 languages with near-human accuracy. Runs locally for free.

whisperx.name: WhisperX
whisperx.description: Automatic speech recognition with word-level timestamps and speaker diarization (who spoke when). 70x faster than Whisper with batched inference.

libreTranslate.name: LibreTranslate
libreTranslate.description: Free and open-source machine translation API that can be self-hosted. No limits, no tracking. Supports 30 languages via Argos Translate backend.

argos-translate.name: Argos Translate
argos-translate.description: Offline open-source translation library that works without internet. Install language packs and translate privately with no API calls.

languagetool.name: LanguageTool
languagetool.description: Open-source grammar and style checker supporting 30+ languages. Self-hostable, available as browser extension, with no data leaving your machine.

localai.name: LocalAI
localai.description: Free, open-source OpenAI API-compatible server that runs locally. Drop-in replacement for OpenAI API — no GPU required, supports LLMs, image generation, and TTS.

litellm.name: LiteLLM
litellm.description: Open-source proxy server for 100+ LLM APIs. Unified OpenAI-compatible interface for Anthropic, Groq, Gemini, Ollama, and more. Built-in cost tracking.

stable-video.name: Stable Video Diffusion
stable-video.description: Stability AI's open-weight video generation model. Generate short video clips from images locally. Runs on consumer GPUs.

wan-video.name: Wan2.1
wan-video.description: State-of-the-art open-source video generation model by Alibaba. Generates high-quality, physically realistic videos from text prompts. Apache licensed.

appflowy-ai.name: AppFlowy AI
appflowy-ai.description: Open-source Notion alternative with local AI support via Ollama. AI writing, summarisation, and document Q&A — all running on your own machine.
